overview: Rapid review with stated shortcuts: an update search from June 2021 building on the 2022 meta-analysis, focused on 30-day safety, rule-out yield overall and in older and kidney patients, time in the department, and second-sample timing failures.
population: Adults with suspected myocardial infarction assessed with a one-hour high-sensitivity troponin pathway in emergency departments or chest pain units; studies from 2015 in English.
exposure: One-hour rule-out pathway (samples at presentation and at about one hour, rule-out below assay-specific thresholds). Comparator where reported: three-hour pathway.
procedures: The librarian runs a dated search of three databases from June 2021 and checks the 2022 meta-analysis's included studies. One reviewer screens and a second checks a random 20 percent; one reviewer extracts and a second checks all safety and yield values. Risk of bias is judged with a short tool for accuracy and before-after studies. Conference abstracts are listed but not graded or pooled unless a full report exists.

outcomes.name: 30-day death or myocardial infarction after rule-out
outcomes.measure: Proportion of ruled-out patients with death or myocardial infarction within 30 days
outcomes.why: The safety outcome the committee must be sure of.

outcomes.name: Rule-out yield
outcomes.measure: Proportion of tested patients ruled out at one hour, overall and by age 75 or over and kidney function
outcomes.why: Determines the time saved for this unit's case mix.

outcomes.name: Time in the department
outcomes.measure: Median hours from arrival to discharge for ruled-out patients

outcomes.name: Second-sample timing failures
outcomes.measure: Proportion of second samples outside the 45 to 75 minute window

feasibility: Ten librarian hours and about 12 reviewer days over six weeks; the 2022 meta-analysis supplies most studies before June 2021.
biasMitigation: Dated search and every shortcut reported
Second reviewer checks all safety and yield extractions
Conference abstracts listed but not graded or pooled
Setting and age tabulated for each study to judge indirectness

biasFlags.label: Selective outcome follow-up
biasFlags.note: 30-day capture outside the study region is often unclear.

flags: Subgroups limited to age 75 or over and kidney function
parsimony.simplestPath: One safety outcome, two yield and time outcomes and one process measure from an update of an existing review.

theoreticalFramework: None; the review answers a safety and yield question for a pathway decision.
summary: Update rapid review with one primary safety outcome, two secondary outcomes and one process measure.
